verdict.rationale: The only migration-specific evidence is a help-center article title phrased as a question ("How do I migrate to Digits from Quickbooks?"). It hints that a guide exists but documents no import capability, no supported source systems beyond the title, and nothing about preserving transaction-level detail. The batch transaction sync API with external-ID idempotence is a developer building block a developer could use to construct a migration, not a migration feature itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
